findings.finding: TD SYNNEX's Europe distribution gross billings for June-August 2026 rose 26.0% yoy (22.6% the prior quarter), roughly +27% in EUR, so European IT channel value did not decelerate in the months overlapping Atea's Q3, which supports the company's 'more of the same' Q3 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Atea's quarter-vs-consensus has driven large moves: Q1 2026 beat (+6.5% EPS) +7.82%; Q2 2026 miss (-7.5%) -4.85% on 2026-07-16; Q4 2025 miss -1.62%; Q3 2025 miss +1.22%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a US distributor's segment table, not a Nordic data point, but it lands inside what Atea already guided, so it adds little: if the market doubted the guide, the 3-analyst EPS estimate would have been cut, and it has moved only from 2.52 to 2.49.
findings.independence: Softcat FY26 (to July) hardware gross invoiced income +41.6% on data-centre/networking: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-softcat-h2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-10-14/

findings.finding: Pull-forward payback risk for the outlook: IDC's preliminary Q3 2026 global PC shipments fell 20.1% yoy (62.7m units) after channels stockpiled in H1, and IDC says the next quarters may get worse; this lands on Atea's forward commentary, since its own CEO said half of Q2's 21% hardware growth came from the supply/price situation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Atea gives qualitative outlook only; quarters with a cautious tone or a miss have been sold hard (Q2 2024 -5.87%, Q4 2024 -6.55%, Q2 2025 -6.53%), and confident ones bought (Q3 2024 +7.27%, Q1 2026 +7.82%).
findings.original_quote: las perspectivas de los próximos trimestres podrían empeorar antes de mejorar (the outlook for the next few quarters could get worse before it improves) -- source is Spanish-language reporting of IDC
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: IDC was public on 2026-10-08/09 and the stock is -5.1% over 20 sessions and -2.9% over 5. Unit data is not Atea's value data (prices +, data-centre mix), so the macro-to-company link is a hypothesis; if the market had fully priced a payback, the Q4 EPS estimate (3.40) would have been cut, and it has not moved.
findings.independence: Dustin Q4 2025/26 (Jun-Aug) organic -3% ex consumer, 'higher prices may weigh on workplace demand': https://quartr.com/events/dustin-group-dust-q4-25-26_3sDtmSrZ ; Softcat flags FY26 pull-forward and guides FY27 operating profit growth to high single digits: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-softcat-h2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-10-14/

findings.finding: The krone strengthened further in Q3: SEK/NOK averaged -7.2% and EUR/NOK -7.3% yoy in Q3 2026 against -5.5%/-6.1% in Q2, when Atea reported a -5.8% currency drag, so reported NOK growth will run below the 'H1 trends' that management guided.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separately visible; in Q2 2026 the -5.8% FX drag was part of a quarter that missed EPS and fell 4.85%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: FX is public and the consensus IFRS revenue estimate (NOK 9.25bn, +9.7% yoy) already sits below the H1 reported growth rate (+13.5%). The residual is only that the guide was not FX-qualified.
findings.independence: EUR/NOK series: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/EURNOK=X?range=2y&interval=1d ; Atea's Q2 FX drag: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=678255

findings.finding: Q3 operating cash flow is a scheduled test of the promised inventory release: Q2 operating cash flow was -NOK 727m (vs -111m) on a deliberate inventory build, and the CFO said inventory would be reduced with H2 hardware deliveries.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: strong growth, EPS miss and the -727m cash outflow, and the stock fell 4.85% on 2026-07-16.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither direction has a sourced pointer: the release is promised (positive) while Dustin and IDC say shortages last into 2027 (which could hold inventory up). Sized at 0 because the sign is unknown; it widens the move rather than signing it.
findings.independence: Dustin: 'Component shortages are expected to sustain higher prices and constrain availability into 2027' https://quartr.com/events/dustin-group-dust-q4-25-26_3sDtmSrZ

findings.finding: Atea has missed the Yahoo EPS consensus in 3 of the last 4 quarters (Q3 2025 -4.8%, Q4 2025 -6.9%, Q2 2026 -7.5%; beat Q1 2026 +6.5%), and the Q3 2026 bar of NOK 2.49 already assumes about +24% EPS growth.
findings.why_not_priced: A base-rate pattern rather than a fact about this quarter; three analysts have kept the bar in the guide's range rather than cutting it, so a market that had priced a habitual miss would show a cut estimate or a crowded short, and neither is there.
